text:
tina: Hey CS team — first day! Quick access questions: I don't have HubSpot/Gong/Dialpad yet. Who should I ping for seats? Also where's the CS playbook + call templates? Need to prep for shadowing later today.

sam: Welcome Tina! Congrats. For HubSpot and Gong, ping IT via this form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk (or DM me and I can fast-track). Dialpad seats come from Sales Ops — @julie handles them.

julie: Hi Tina — added you to the Dialpad queue. Expect seat invite in ~2 hours. Quick checklist: 1) Accept SSO invite 2) set up MFA 3) enable voicemail forwarding. If anything blocks, @sam can escalate.

sam: CS playbook lives in Notion: https://redwood.notion.so/CS-Playbook (see 'Week 0 - Shadowing' and 'Call Templates'). Call templates -> Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/CS/ops/call-templates. Also note: Gong transcription + recordings are enabled for the CS team by default; retention 90 days. If you need exports, ask Legal.

tina: Awesome — what's the recommended email subject for IT ticket? I tried the form but it asked for 'seat type' and I wasn't sure.

sam: Use: "Seat request: Tina — CS (HubSpot, Gong, Dialpad)" and attach your manager's approval. For HubSpot role pick 'CS - Rep'. For Gong choose 'Basic + Recordings'.

it-bot: Ticket #CS-4321 created by tina: "Seat request: Tina — CS (HubSpot, Gong, Dialpad)". Status: In progress.

julie: Also FYI, call collateral (battle cards, objection scripts) is in Drive -> CS/Collateral/Q1-playbooks. If you want quick practice, pair with @mike for shadowing at 2pm.

tina: Thanks! One more — are call summaries auto-pushed to HubSpot notes or do we manually paste?

sam: Gong can auto-push transcripts to HubSpot if you enable 'Session Sync' — we usually keep it on. If it's off for you, DM me and I'll turn it on.

tina: Great. I'll DM. Thanks everyone :tada:

julie: Welcome aboard! :party_parrot:

sam: Welcome!! If you hit any blocker, drop in #help or ping me directly.
